mission.guide.supply_road: The Market's shelf is empty — use the Road tool to link a supply site to your Market's road.
mission.guide.await_caravan: A caravan is on its way: buying opens once the shelf fills. Select the Market to watch it.
mission.guide.draw_road: {building} is built but unlinked — use the Road tool to connect it to the Centre's road.
mission.chain_abandoned: The story chain is closed. The match continues as a free game.
mission.build.already_building: {building} is already being built — wait for it to finish.
mission.build.one_is_enough: One {building} is enough for this objective.
mission.frontier_road.name: The Frontier Road
mission.frontier_road.intro: The King has sent you to an abandoned frontier valley. The Centre is your first store: every building touching the free road around it works for the treasury. Right-click to send troops · WASD to move the map.
mission.frontier_road.intro_fog: Most of the valley lies under fog: only what your units and buildings can see stays clear. Send a unit scouting to learn what your rival is doing.
mission.frontier_road.outro: Your rival lord's forward outpost has fallen. The valley is yours. Pick regional victory in a free match and the strategic passes become a second way to win: a pass is held by the control radius of a road-linked outpost, not by troops standing on it.
The Centre is your first store; whatever a building on its road harvests flows into the treasury.
First food comes from the hunt: put the camp by the deer, touching the road. The Farm opens at Centre Lv2.
mission.frontier_road.step.first_depot.w: Deliveries stop once the Centre's store is full; a Depot raises the ceiling.
mission.frontier_road.step.market.title: Build a Market
mission.frontier_road.step.market.why: The Market costs 20 wood; it turns what you have spare into what you need.
mission.frontier_road.step.supply_wood.t: Run a Road to the Timber Camp
mission.frontier_road.step.supply_wood.w: The Market sells only what is hauled in: the shelf fills from the supply site you link by road.
mission.frontier_road.step.buy_wood.why: Select the Market: sell food, buy wood with the gold. The shelf only holds what the caravans have brought.
mission.frontier_road.step.center_lv2.wh: The upgrade is ordered at the Centre and takes effect on all of your buildings at once.
mission.frontier_road.step.houses.title: Build a House
mission.frontier_road.step.houses.why: At the population cap you can train neither workers nor soldiers; a House raises it.
mission.frontier_road.step.train_workers: Production buildings keep the idle workers they draw; with none to spare, a building simply stands empty.
mission.frontier_road.step.second_lumber: The age transition's wood bill is larger than one camp can cut; a second camp closes the gap.
mission.frontier_road.step.second_farm.w: The Centre reached Level 2, so the Farm is open. The hunt runs out eventually; a field does not.
mission.frontier_road.step.outpost.title: Build an Outpost
mission.frontier_road.step.outpost.why: An outpost widens your control radius — wider still once it is linked by road.
mission.frontier_road.step.quarry.title: Build a Quarry
mission.frontier_road.step.quarry.why: A quarry is raised on top of a stone deposit; its road has to reach the Centre's network.
mission.frontier_road.step.gold_mine.why: Gold is the slowest resource: it pays for the Market and for the age transition alike.
mission.frontier_road.step.barracks.why: Your rival lord wants this valley too; the larger your economy grows, the more you look like a target.
mission.frontier_road.step.guards.title: Train Three Guards
mission.frontier_road.step.guards.why: An enemy standing on your depot cuts the line without razing the building.
mission.frontier_road.step.hold_stance.t: Set the Guards to Hold Position
mission.frontier_road.step.hold_stance.w: On the free stance a unit chases what it sees and leaves your line open; on hold it stays put.
mission.frontier_road.step.town.title: Advance to the Town Age
mission.frontier_road.step.town.why: The Town Age opens new buildings and units; you are weak while the transition runs.
mission.frontier_road.step.archery_range: The first military building the Town Age opens: an archer strikes from range, a guard has to close.
mission.frontier_road.step.defend.title: Defeat Three Enemy Units
mission.frontier_road.step.defend.why: The rival lord wants the valley back; until you use your army you are only a target.
mission.frontier_road.step.raze.title: Raze Your Rival's Outpost
mission.frontier_road.step.raze.why: When the outpost falls, your rival loses both its control radius and its production efficiency.
